profiles.notes: Nicosia, Cyprus. Each requirement refers to the named degree, entry route and applicant background.

requirements.label: School-leaving certificate · grades and subjects
requirements.details: Present 90% overall, or 18/20 on the Greek or Cypriot school-leaving certificate. Present similar grades in biology and one of chemistry, physics or mathematics.

source.title: University of Nicosia · School-leaving certificate

requirements.label: GCE A levels · ABB
requirements.details: Present ABB across three A levels. Include biology and at least one of chemistry, physics or mathematics. The university does not assign the A to a particular subject.

source.title: University of Nicosia · GCE A-level route

requirements.label: Review of science preparation
requirements.details: The school reviews the complete grade record, including chemistry, physics and mathematics, to assess readiness for the course. Other qualifications are assessed individually.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Assessment of academic preparation

requirements.label: Relevant degree · first-year consideration
requirements.details: A bachelor’s degree in a field related to medicine may qualify an applicant for consideration for year one of the six-year MD.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Degree-holder entry

requirements.label: Relevant degree · first-year veterinary entry
requirements.details: The veterinary school considers applicants holding a relevant bachelor’s degree for admission to year one.

source.title: University of Nicosia · DVM degree-holder entry

requirements.label: English tests · clinical degree routes
requirements.details: Present IELTS 6.5 overall, including 6.5 in writing and 6.0 in each remaining component, or an equivalent test. The stated TOEFL iBT options are 79 on the earlier scale or 4 on the scale applicable from 22 January 2026.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Clinical admissions · English tests

requirements.label: School English qualifications · clinical degree routes
requirements.details: English at GCSE grade 5 (B on the earlier scale), IB Standard Level grade 5, or European Baccalaureate grade 8 satisfies the school-qualification English route.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Clinical admissions · school English qualifications

requirements.label: MD English exemption · native speakers
requirements.details: Native English speakers originating from Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States qualify for the stated exemption.

source.title: University of Nicosia · MD English exemption

requirements.label: Canadian English-medium school · six-year MD
requirements.details: Applicants from English-speaking Canadian provinces must provide an official high-school letter confirming English-medium teaching or provide the specified English proficiency evidence.

source.title: University of Nicosia · English evidence for Canadian applicants

requirements.label: Canadian English-medium education · graduate-entry MD
requirements.details: Applicants from English-speaking Canadian provinces must provide official English-medium letters from both high school and university or meet a listed English proficiency requirement.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Graduate-entry MD · English documentation

requirements.label: Graduate-entry MD · earlier English certificates
requirements.details: EU/EEA passport holders graduating from an English-medium university in one of the six listed countries other than their country of origin may be able to use the certificate submitted for admission there. For this route the school requires third-country nationals to supply the specified English evidence for the student visa regardless of the language of their first degree.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Graduate-entry MD · language documentation

requirements.label: DVM · English-medium school exemption
requirements.details: Applicants from Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK, the US or English-speaking Canadian provinces qualify for exemption if they graduated from an English-medium high school.

source.title: University of Nicosia · DVM English exemption

requirements.label: MD online selection interview
requirements.details: Both MD routes require an online interview assessing readiness to complete medical training and practise professionally.

source.title: University of Nicosia · MD interviews

requirements.label: MD volunteering evidence
requirements.details: Applicants must use volunteer experience to demonstrate understanding of the biological, psychological and social aspects of medicine.

source.title: University of Nicosia · MD volunteer experience

requirements.label: DVM interview
requirements.details: Attend an interview online or in person to assess suitability for veterinary training and practice.

source.title: University of Nicosia · DVM interview

requirements.label: Veterinary volunteering evidence
requirements.details: Show through volunteer experience how you understand the biological, psychological and social aspects of veterinary practice.

source.title: University of Nicosia · DVM volunteer experience

requirements.label: Six-year MD · conditions before enrolment
requirements.details: The committee reviews academic and non-academic conditions throughout selection. Applicants holding a conditional offer must meet the applicable conditions before enrolment.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Conditions of enrolment

requirements.label: Graduate-entry MD · bachelor’s degree
requirements.details: Hold a bachelor’s degree in any discipline at UK 2:2 honours or an equivalent GPA, and meet one of the entrance-exam routes. The UCAT route has its own degree-field restriction.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Graduate-entry MD · academic eligibility

requirements.label: Graduate-entry MD · MCAT option
requirements.details: The MCAT route requires a score of at least 498.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Entrance examinations · MCAT

requirements.label: Graduate-entry MD · GAMSAT option
requirements.details: The GAMSAT route requires at least 55 overall and at least 50 in every section.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Entrance examinations · GAMSAT

requirements.label: Graduate-entry MD · UCAT option
requirements.details: Only applicants with a life sciences or biomedical sciences BSc at UK 2:2 honours or equivalent may use the UCAT. They need 1875 overall, at least 500 in each scored section and situational judgement Band 1, 2 or 3.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Entrance examinations · UCAT

requirements.label: Graduate-entry MD · applicants from Israel
requirements.details: Applicants from Israel may replace the listed entrance exam with a Tel Aviv University or Reichman University Yeda score of at least 300 overall.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Entrance examinations · Yeda

profiles.notes: Nicosia, Cyprus. Each requirement refers to the named degree, entry route and applicant background.

requirements.label: Six-year MD · transfer to years two or three
requirements.details: An applicant in good standing at an accredited medical school may be considered for year two or three after an academic panel examines completed courses.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Nicosia six-year MD · transfer review

profiles.notes: Distance-learning degrees offered by the University of Nicosia. The two family medicine programmes use different languages and recommendation criteria.

requirements.label: Family medicine · medical qualification
requirements.details: Hold a medical degree from a recognised institution.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Family medicine master’s admission

requirements.label: Family medicine · medical registration
requirements.details: Provide evidence of current medical registration. For the joint Greek-language course, registration is with the medical association in the country of practice.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Family medicine master’s registration

requirements.label: English-language family medicine · ongoing practice
requirements.details: Remain in clinical practice throughout enrolment in the MSc.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Clinical practice

requirements.label: English-language family medicine · professional referees
requirements.details: Submit two professional recommendation letters.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Reference letters

requirements.label: English-language family medicine · online interview
requirements.details: The online interview assesses clinical professionalism and commitment, empathy, resilience, initiative, communication, teamwork, organisation and problem-solving.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Family medicine interview

requirements.label: Joint family medicine · language and clinical work
requirements.details: Demonstrate Greek proficiency and be in clinical practice with access to patients. The universities give native Greek with Greek-medium secondary or medical education as an example of language evidence.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Joint programme · Greek and clinical practice

requirements.label: Joint family medicine · recommendation letters
requirements.details: Submit two academic recommendations or one academic and one professional recommendation.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Joint programme · references

requirements.label: Joint family medicine · selection interview
requirements.details: Eligible applicants are invited to a video interview. Submit the application to the University of Nicosia for this joint programme with the University of Patras.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Joint programme · selection

requirements.label: Public health · prior university degree
requirements.details: Hold a bachelor’s degree from an institution recognised in its country of operation. Medicine, health sciences, biological sciences, social sciences and environmental sciences are advantageous backgrounds.

source.title: University of Nicosia · MPH academic requirements

requirements.label: Public health · referee
requirements.details: Submit one academic or professional recommendation.

source.title: University of Nicosia · MPH reference

requirements.label: Public health · personal statement
requirements.details: In at most 800 words, describe relevant previous experience, the degree’s connection to your goals and your ability to work alone and in a team, set priorities and monitor your progress in distance learning.

source.title: University of Nicosia · MPH personal statement

requirements.label: Family medicine · IELTS
requirements.details: The English-language MSc requires IELTS 6.5 overall with 6.5 in writing and at least 6.0 in the other components if using IELTS.

source.title: University of Nicosia · MSc English language · IELTS

requirements.label: Public health · IELTS
requirements.details: For the IELTS route, the MPH specifies 6.5 overall and 6.0 in the other elements.

source.title: University of Nicosia · MPH English language · IELTS

requirements.label: Public health and English-language family medicine · alternative English qualifications
requirements.details: The programmes list TOEFL iBT 79, GCSE English grade 5 or the older grade B, IB Standard Level English 5, or European Baccalaureate English 8.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Online degrees · English qualifications

requirements.label: English-medium study · online MSc and MPH exemptions
requirements.details: The school lists native English speakers from Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK and the US whose earlier education was taught in English. Third-country nationals with an English-taught degree from one of those countries must provide the English certification used for entry to that degree to claim an exemption.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Online degrees · English exemptions

profiles.notes: Nicosia, Cyprus. Each requirement refers to the named degree, entry route and applicant background.

requirements.label: Medical sciences doctorate · prior degrees
requirements.details: The school states that recognised bachelor’s and master’s degrees or equivalents should be held by registration, and specifically identifies a medical degree as the Medical School’s minimum qualification.

source.title: University of Nicosia · PhD · academic prerequisites

requirements.label: Doctorate · transcripts and degree certificates
requirements.details: Scanned degree certificates and transcripts are accepted for assessment. Certified true copies are required before enrolment.

source.title: University of Nicosia · PhD · supporting documents

requirements.label: Doctorate · CV and references
requirements.details: Submit a CV and two recommendation letters, including at least one academic reference.

source.title: University of Nicosia · PhD · references and CV

requirements.label: Doctorate · English and writing
requirements.details: IELTS requires 7 overall and at least 7 in writing, or TOEFL iBT 94 overall and at least 27 in writing. Other internationally recognised qualifications may be reviewed. Native-English-speaking nationals of the UK, Ireland, US, Australia, New Zealand and English-speaking Canada are exempt from the test certificate.

source.title: University of Nicosia · PhD · English evidence

requirements.label: Doctorate · proposal and research supervision
requirements.details: Align the proposed project with a Medical School research priority. The proposed main supervisor reviews the original proposal for approval before application. Include the research question, existing literature, methods and budget. The school gives 5–8 pages and about 2,000–3,000 words. Applicants to a specific faculty scholarship or research project are exempt from submitting this proposal at the initial stage.

source.title: University of Nicosia · Developing the PhD proposal
